questions.prompt: What are the default chunk settings for files added to an OpenAI vector store?

options.explanation: Right. The OpenAI retrieval guide gives these as the defaults for `max_chunk_size_tokens` and `chunk_overlap_tokens`.

options.text: 4096-token chunks with no overlap between them
options.explanation: 4096 is the largest chunk size you may set, not the default. The default also has overlap.

options.text: One chunk per page, with no overlap
options.explanation: OpenAI chunks by tokens, not pages. The default is 800 tokens with 400 overlapping.

questions.prompt: On OpenAI, you set `max_chunk_size_tokens` to 1000. Which overlap stays inside the documented limit?

options.explanation: That is more than the chunk itself. The overlap should not exceed half the chunk size, here 500.
700 is more than half of 1000, so it breaks the limit.
Right. The overlap should not exceed `max_chunk_size_tokens / 2`, and 1000 / 2 is 500.
That would make two neighbouring chunks identical. The limit is half the chunk size.

questions.prompt: In Contextual Retrieval, what is added to each chunk before it is embedded?

options.text: A copy of the full document
options.explanation: The model reads the full document, but only a short context is added to the chunk.

options.text: A list of keywords picked by a human
options.explanation: Anthropic says manual annotation would be far too much work. A model writes the context.

options.text: Short chunk-specific context, usually 50 to 100 tokens
options.explanation: Right. A model writes it from the whole document and the chunk, and it is prepended before embedding and before the keyword index is built.

options.text: The same summary of the document for every chunk
options.explanation: Anthropic tried adding generic document summaries and saw very limited gains.
